title: DTCR architecture invariant admission
description: The admission record for one rule this repository has agreed to hold. It composes with the violation candidate rather than duplicating it: the candidate carries `invariant_ref` with the same `DTCR-AI-` identifier and the statement written out inline, so a reader of a finding never has to resolve a second document to know what rule was breached; this record is the ledger row that says who admitted that identifier, when, and against which commit. An invariant a retrieval pass surfaced is a candidate invariant and is bound here to CANDIDATE_NOT_ADMITTED, because an invariant is admitted rather than discovered: a document that says the domain layer must not import infrastructure is evidence that somebody once wrote that down, not evidence that it currently binds. Admission is a human act and the record has no field in which any accumulation of technical evidence can substitute for it.

invariant_id.description: The same identifier space the violation candidate's invariant_ref uses. One rule, one identifier, two records with different jobs.

statement.description: The rule written out. A rule referred to only by identifier is a rule nobody can disagree with, and a rule nobody can disagree with is never revised.

origin.description: Where the sentence came from. The last two are proposals about the world; only the first is a decision this repository made.

admitted_by.description: Fixed. Admission belongs to a person; no retrieval hit, static pass or green suite can be written in this field.

subsystem_scope.description: Which subsystems the rule binds. An invariant with no stated scope is read as binding everything, which is how a local rule becomes a repository-wide false positive.

then.description: An invariant a retrieval pass found, or one an outside document recommended, is a candidate. Promoting it here would let a stored sentence bind this tree without anybody agreeing to it.
ADMITTED with the admission literal NOT_ADMITTED beside it is a rule that admitted itself.

examples.statement: Domain modules must not import infrastructure modules.

x-refusal-controls.refuses: An invariant a retrieval pass surfaced, recorded as admitted.

admission.decision_ref: top-ranked retrieval hit on an older decision record

x-refusal-controls.refuses: An invariant marked admitted with no admission behind it.

instance.statement: Every outbound request carries a deadline.

x-refusal-controls.refuses: A rule carried by identifier alone, with no sentence anybody could disagree with.
An older invariant recorded as overriding a newer explicit decision.

instance.statement: All persistence goes through the legacy data access layer.
